agenda_items.title: Notices and meeting information for meeting participants and the public
agenda_items.description:
Members of Committee and Council, City staff, media and the general public may join the meeting with this link:
Zoom meeting no. 816 1070 9295
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and remote participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
The deadline to register to speak, or submit written comments is 4 pm on the day of the meeting.

agenda_items.title: Declarations of Interest
agenda_items.minutes: No Declarations of Interest were filed.

sub_agendas_items.title: Provincial and Federal Accessibility Plan Updates
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
The Accessibility Office delivered an update on Provincial and Federal Accessibility Plans. The presentation was led by Megan Richards, Program Manager in the Accessibility Office, Sarah Beriault, Corporate Accessibility Specialist in the Accessibility Office, and Rob Prud’homme, Corporate Accessibility Specialist in the Accessibility Office. A copy of the slide presentation is filed with the Clerk.
There was one delegation for this item:
Kevin Wherry, Manager, Parks and Facilities Planning from the Recreation, Cultural & Facility Services Department; Megan Richards, Program Manager in the Accessibility Office; Sarah Beriault, Corporate Accessibility Specialist in the Accessibility Office; and Rob Prud’homme, Corporate Accessibility Specialist in the Accessibility Office, were available to answer questions from members.
Members discussed the following issues:

motions.motion_text:
Report Recommendation(s)
That the Accessibility Advisory Committee receive the presentation and provide feedback as appropriate.
